Question 3
?

Find the first three non-zero terms of the Maclaurin expansion of the function f(x)=x2x.

a
 x2x=x+(ln⁡2)x2+(ln⁡2)2x32+⋯
b
 x2x=x+(ln⁡2)x2+(ln⁡2)2x36+⋯
c
 x2x=1+x+x26+⋯
d
x2x=1+(ln⁡2)x+(ln⁡2)2x22+⋯
e
 x2x=x+x2+x33+⋯
